controls.label: Gender
controls.effect: ±2 flips the gender of every release voice; identity drops to ~0.5

controls.label: Age
controls.effect: ±2 moves apparent age by 10-30 years; at −3 male voices start to read female

controls.label: Pitch
controls.effect: ±2: about −20 / +40 Hz at the same gender; +3 can flip a female voice

controls.label: Intonation
controls.effect: ±2: F0 spread 2.9 → 2.1 / 4.4 semitones at the same pitch level

controls.label: Bright

controls.label: Raspy

controls.label: Soft

controls.label: Authority

controls.label: Room

controls.label: Projection

controls.label: Pace

controls.label: Liveliness
